name: Iori Tenjuu
source:
She is a first-year student at Chloe Women's Middle School.

Unlike her calmer older sister, she has an air of mystery about what is going on in her mind.

This is her first time being with a man other than her father.
And that man is Hisaya.

[translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/az/wakaba_top.html]official website[/url]]
